chunks: By the Lord of the heavens and the earth, this is certainly true even as you speak.

key_terms.رَبِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ: Lord of the heavens and the earth

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'By the Lord of the heavens and the earth' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the certainty of the Resurrection and the truthfulness of the Prophets, with the oath by the Lord of the heavens and earth underscoring the majesty of the Creator. The comparison to human speech highlights the tangible, undeniable nature of divine promise, a concept frequently linked to the infallibility of the Ahl al-Bayt as the bearers of this truth. This affirmation serves as a theological anchor for believers, reinforcing the inevitability of divine justice.
